name: Assabu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Assabu town emblem in yellow and green: a slanted rectangle bearing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Assabu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 30 March 1968.

features.role: Assabu town emblem — a slanted rectangle bearing a stylised character
